source.source_revision: Wahapedia Space Marines App 2.8.1 / October 2026; stable Last_update 2026-10-19 03:47:32; live page checked 2026-10-27.
source.chapter_context: Shared-book Space Marines profile with the source-listed ULTRAMARINES keyword. Chapter roster restrictions and Chapter-specific effects are outside this local datasheet scope.
source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 11th edition through the local match/action runtime; this is not full-match certification.

fixed_data_comparison.limit: The comparator does not validate per-model base sizes; those were independently checked against Datasheets_models.csv in the pinned local export.

scope: Exact six-model, 115-point EPIC HERO profile; no equipment-option rows; one-copy local construction cap.

Every model's characteristics and base geometry are source-matched. Aemelia Minervas 28.5 mm; Ancient Gadriel 40 mm; Dainal Kornelius 28.5 mm; Gaius Silva 28.5 mm; Lucia Vestha 28.5 mm; Veteran Sergeant Metaurus 40 mm.

Model-specific defense and keywords: Ancient Gadriel has OC 2; Gaius Silva has a 5+ invulnerable save; Metaurus has T5, Sv 3+, W4 and a 4+ invulnerable save; Dainal alone has the PSYKER keyword. The source spells Dainal's surname Komelius in the characteristics table and Kornelius in the loadout/composition text.
All nine distinct fixed weapon profiles, including both Bolt Rifle profiles, match the pinned export and pass Equipment/AttackPlan materialization for the model carrying them.
Both players materialize from current Space Marines catalogs; all four source-listed abilities register; duplicate Wardens are rejected.

Support map matches the four shared-book targets: Assault Intercessor Squad, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Intercessor Squad and Sternguard Veteran Squad. The separate Vanguard Veteran Squad target on Wahapedia is a Legends datasheet and remains outside the common-book 85.
Raise the Banner secures an objective controlled by Wardens at the end of their own Movement phase and does not trigger at the opponent's Movement-phase end.

Strategium Command starts after deployment and before Scouts; validates ownership and normal battlefield redeployment restrictions; confirms legal redeployment; moves a selected unit to Strategic Reserves with its points-cap exception; and stops after three distinct units.

supplementary_regression.command: python tools/verify.py --godot .tools/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --profile targeted --only test_marine_wardens_profile --only test_space_marine_leader_links --only test_ancients --only test_company_heroes_current --only test_implemented_catalog --timeout 300
supplementary_regression.note: Shared Leader/Support links, Ancients, Company Heroes and catalog regression passed. This broader run staged the optional legacy starter, so clean current-catalog evidence is taken from the focused run above.

limits: Closes only Wardens of Ultramar's common-book local datasheet scope.
The fixed-data comparator's per-profile match is not a full rules certificate.
The export snapshot is dated 2026-10-21 and the page was checked live on 2026-10-27; later source changes require reconciliation.

The Legends Vanguard Veteran Squad target, complete Chapter roster restrictions, full faction/army legality, network behavior, complete-match certification and human playtesting remain outside this closure.
